_comment: Human-verified reference values for IMF Country Report No. 24/192 (Dominica 2024 Article IV). Page numbers are PDF page indices (1-based). VERIFY EACH VALUE AGAINST THE PDF YOURSELF and set verified_by_student to true.

gdp_growth_forecast_pct.source: Table 1. Selected Economic Indicators, row 'Real GDP', column 2024 (PDF p.4 and p.31)

headline_inflation_rate_pct.source: Table 1, Consumer prices: period average 3.5; end of period 2.3 (PDF p.4 and p.31)

central_bank_policy_rate_pct.source: Not reported. Monetary policy is run by the ECCB, a quasi-currency board (Informational Annex, PDF p.62); no policy rate is stated in the report.

non_performing_loan_ratio.source: Table 5a. Financial Stability Indicators - Commercial Banks, 'Nonperforming loans to total gross loans', 2023 (PDF p.36). NOTE: 13.41 is the CREDIT UNION figure (Table 5b).

unemployment_rate_pct.source: Table 1 social indicators header, 'Unemployment rate (2016) 23' (PDF p.31). Stale data point.

tier_1_capital_ratio.source: Not reported. Only 'Regulatory capital ratio' (total capital / RWA) is given: 27.51 for commercial banks in 2023 (Table 5a, PDF p.36).
